title: Degrees swap under the converse digraph
statement:
Let $D$ be a digraph on a finite vertex set, and let $\breve{D}$ be its converse, obtained by reversing the orientation of every arc. Then for each vertex $v$ the indegree and outdegree interchange:
\[
d^{-}_{\breve{D}}(v) = d^{+}_{D}(v)
\qquad\text{and}\qquad
d^{+}_{\breve{D}}(v) = d^{-}_{D}(v),
\]
where $d^{-}$ counts the arcs with head $v$ and $d^{+}$ the arcs with tail $v$.
hypotheses_covered: v is a vertex of D
